powers.name: Tempest King
powers.description: After anyone draws Storm Surge, ignore hazards for the next two draws.

powers.name: Merchant
powers.description: Earn 25 gold each time you harbor. Remaining ships sell for 60 gold each.

powers.name: Siren Queen
powers.description: Collect everyone’s enchanted cards. Gain ships for pairs at round end. Ignore hazards and harbor freely during Siren’s Song.

powers.name: Undead Admiral
powers.description: Plunder sinking captains. After you harbor, curses take 10 extra gold from the pot.

powers.name: Mechanic
powers.description: Three repair tokens save ships. Sell repairs for 100 gold. Ignore Broken Rudder.

powers.name: Tide Watcher
powers.description: Take a secret card each round. Keep its treasure or place it atop the deck at the right moment.

powers.name: Navigator
powers.description: Five tokens protect you for four draws. While sailing, choose which of the last two cards any Echo copies.

powers.name: Cannoneer
powers.description: Fire cannon tokens to force captains to harbor. Alone in the storm, your treasures are doubled.

powers.name: Blood Sailor
powers.description: Earn 35 gold when a starting neighbor sinks. Gain a life when each loses their last ship.

powers.name: Storm Warden
powers.description: Three Warden tokens each save half the pot when you sink. Stack with Escape Ship or Marooned.

powers.name: Cursed Captain
powers.description: Collect the first two curses each round from anyone. Your own curses never reduce the pot.

powers.name: Parrot Whisperer
powers.description: Start with two tokens. Gain one for every Prophecy drawn. Spend tokens to arrange the next two cards.

powers.name: Sea Witch
powers.description: Gather Hexes to gain gold and curse your rivals. Heart tokens save your ships.

powers.name: Ghost Captain
powers.description: Your only ship is indestructible. Earn 30 gold whenever you sink.

powers.name: Marooned Monarch
powers.description: Ignore Marooned. Earn 60 gold whenever another captain is marooned.

powers.name: Storm Swindler
powers.description: Claim the first treasure outside safe waters each round. It pays you instead of the pot.
